export function range(start, end, step = 1) {
  const out = [];
  if (step === 0) throw new RangeError('step must not be zero');
  if (start < end) {
    for (let i = start; i < end; i += step) out.push(i);
  } else {
    for (let i = start; i > end; i += step) out.push(i);
  }
  return out;
}

export function clamp(value, min, max) {
  if (min > max) return clamp(value, max, min);
  if (value < min) return min;
  if (value > max) return max;
  return value;
}

export function chunk(items, size) {
  if (size <= 0) throw new RangeError('size must be positive');
  const chunks = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i += size) {
    chunks.push(items.slice(i, i + size));
  }
  return chunks;
}

export function summarize(rows) {
  const totals = new Map();
  for (const row of rows) {
    const key = String(row.group ?? 'ungrouped');
    const prev = totals.get(key) ?? { count: 0, sum: 0 };
    prev.count += 1;
    prev.sum += Number(row.amount) || 0;
    totals.set(key, prev);
  }
  return [...totals.entries()]
    .map(([group, agg]) => ({
      group,
      count: agg.count,
      total: Number(agg.sum.toFixed(2)),
      mean: agg.count === 0 ? 0 : Number((agg.sum / agg.count).toFixed(2)),
    }))
    .sort((a, b) => (a.group < b.group ? -1 : a.group > b.group ? 1 : 0));
}
export function templateReport(title, rows) {
  const lines = summarize(rows).map((item) => `- ${item.group}: ${item.total} (${item.count} rows)`);
  return [`# ${title}`, '', ...lines, ''].join('\n');
}

export function debounce(fn, waitMs) {
  let timer = null;
  return function debounced(...args) {
    if (timer !== null) clearTimeout(timer);
    timer = setTimeout(() => {
      timer = null;
      fn.apply(this, args);
    }, waitMs);
  };
}

export function pick(source, keys) {
  const out = {};
  for (const key of keys) {
    if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(source, key)) out[key] = source[key];
  }
  return out;
}

export function stableHash(input) {
  const text = typeof input === 'string' ? input : JSON.stringify(input);
  let hash = 2166136261;
  for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i += 1) {
    hash ^= text.charCodeAt(i);
    hash = Math.imul(hash, 16777619);
  }
  return (hash >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
}

export function groupBy(items, keyFn) {
  const out = new Map();
  for (const item of items) {
    const key = keyFn(item);
    if (!out.has(key)) out.set(key, []);
    out.get(key).push(item);
  }
  return out;
}

export function formatBytes(bytes, digits = 1) {
  if (!Number.isFinite(bytes) || bytes <= 0) return '0 B';
  const units = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB', 'TB'];
  const index = Math.min(Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(1024)), units.length - 1);
  const value = bytes / 1024 ** index;
  return `${value.toFixed(index === 0 ? 0 : digits)} ${units[index]}`;
}

export function retry(task, attempts = 3, delayMs = 100) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const attempt = (left) => {
      task().then(resolve).catch((error) => {
        if (left <= 1) reject(error);
        else setTimeout(() => attempt(left - 1), delayMs * (attempts - left + 1));
      });
    };
    attempt(attempts);
  });
}

export function mergeDeep(target, source) {
  const out = { ...target };
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(source ?? {})) {
    const current = out[key];
    if (value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)
      && current && typeof current === 'object' && !Array.isArray(current)) {
      out[key] = mergeDeep(current, value);
    } else {
      out[key] = value;
    }
  }
  return out;
}
